basis: Original PDF5.1-5.3 and current typed management/database/service/tenant/credential source. Includes registered read contracts omitted from source-contract-only candidate inventory.

families.semantics: Auth/PostgREST/Realtime/Storage configuration get/set are distinct service resources. Disk/autoscale/shutdown helpers are supporting administrative actions, not configuration aliases. Current settings and working exposure must be preserved.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Network bans, restrictions and SSL settings are distinct; restrictions.set/apply must be compared by concrete request behavior rather than name. Preserve current connectivity and exact allowlist/SSL preimages; enriched ban reads are supporting diagnostics.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Branch create/list/get and bound merge/delete retain parent-project/branch identity. Diff/push/reset/restore/config operations are supporting branch lifecycle variants, not alternate merge outcomes. Merge requires actual schema/data/readiness evidence.
unresolved_capabilities: Actual authorized branch merge and parent/child schema/data/readiness verification; bound metadata does not prove merge.

families.semantics: db.diff is a bounded database comparison contract, not arbitrary SQL execution or migration apply. Source/target schema identity, supported object coverage and drift must be checked independently.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Backup listing and restore/PITR use existing project backup resources and entitlements. Schedule changes/undo are supporting operations. A restore request is not a restored, healthy database; destructive impact and rollback require exact decision.
unresolved_capabilities: Exact reviewed existing backup/PITR target and independent restore/health/integrity evidence.

families.semantics: Table/view/materialized-view creation/alter/drop/refresh use typed database contracts and scoped migration custody. Existing provider-read catalogue lists remain required even though absent from the source-contract-only inventory. OpenAPI paths are supporting, not full schema inspection.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Functions/procedures/triggers have distinct create/replace/drop/enable/disable semantics. Catalogue reads and dependency/privilege verification remain required; generic SQL capability does not establish every concrete lifecycle.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Indexes/constraints/types/extensions have distinct validation, enum changes and supported-extension upgrade behavior. List/introspection comes from existing provider-read contracts and cannot be dropped by source-only inventory filtering.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Roles/grants/default privileges are security-sensitive and scoped to supported customer roles. Existing default privileges affect future objects, not current grants. Privilege inheritance, membership and tenant separation need actual least-privilege verification.
unresolved_capabilities: Security-reviewed role/membership/grant/default-privilege lifecycle across supported tenant roles, with nonowner behavior tests.

families.semantics: RLS table enable/disable and policy create/alter/drop/list are distinct. Policy DDL success is insufficient: authenticated/anon/foreign-tenant SQL must establish isolation. No live RLS disable is authorized here.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Publication CRUD/list is only part of logical replication/CDC. Slots/subscriptions, replica identity, WAL retention and delivery/recovery must be accounted for; publication metadata does not establish data replication.
unresolved_capabilities: Logical replication/CDC slot/subscription and actual delivery/recovery coverage beyond publication DDL.

families.semantics: Insert/upsert/update/delete and bounded bulk import/export retain typed table/tenant/filter and custody constraints. Uniqueness/conflict handling, transactionality, large transfers and exact row effects require real evidence.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Inspect/explain/analyze/vacuum/reindex and maintenance receipts differ. EXPLAIN ANALYZE may execute work; maintenance outside a transaction needs durable completion. Configuration changes are supporting, not generic maintenance aliases.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Connections/locks/slow queries and pooler/postgres configuration are separate. Cancel versus terminate has different session effects; SQL text and connections can contain private data. Legacy pooler get is not assumed equivalent without projection review.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Restore-point create/get is metadata and WAL positioning, not a full physical/logical backup artifact, restore or integrity verification. Shared backups.list/restore provide prerequisites only; isolated recovery remains required.
unresolved_capabilities: Real backup artifact/snapshot custody, isolated restore and integrity verification beyond restore-point metadata.

families.semantics: Cron job create/update/delete/list is schedule metadata; exact execution identity, run history, failure/retry and side-effect idempotency remain requirements. No scheduling of live side effects is authorized by this review.
unresolved_capabilities: Actual authorized cron execution/run-history and retry/idempotency evidence.

families.semantics: Database webhooks enable/list does not cover complete receiver configuration, update/delete or authenticated event delivery. Extension availability and durable transaction/event behavior remain explicit gaps.
unresolved_capabilities: Concrete webhook create/update/delete/configuration and authenticated event delivery/recovery contracts beyond enable/list.

families.semantics: Provider/SSO/signing-key/third-party integrations, sessions and MFA are different resources. Shared auth configuration handles provider/hook settings; token/session revocation and functional MFA/hook behavior remain requirements beyond listing/deleting factors.
unresolved_capabilities: Explicit current session/token revocation and complete MFA/provider/hook lifecycle with functional authentication evidence.

families.semantics: Bucket CRUD/empty and metadata listing have different provider effects. Scoped tenant bucket ownership, retention, public/private settings and purge must be tested; empty/delete is not authorized as a metadata read.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Object metadata get/exists/list is not byte download. Upload/update/copy/move/delete/download must prove exact bytes, version/preconditions, cross-tenant denial and recovery; signed delivery and large/resumable transfer remain distinct obligations.
unresolved_capabilities: Signed/large/resumable object transfer and exact byte/generation/scanner custody evidence.

families.semantics: Storage policies are tenant-bound SQL access rules, not bucket configuration. Create/update/delete/list must be tested with actual authorized and foreign object requests, preserving normal application access.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Realtime channel definitions, private permissions and a bounded subscribe probe are not global live-client inventory. Shared publication operations are required; broadcasts, reconnect/resume and tenant isolation need functional delivery evidence.
unresolved_capabilities: Publication integration, actual broadcast/subscription delivery and reconnect/resume isolation.

families.semantics: Managed vault versions and provider credential adopt/activate/verify/reconcile/rollback are separate private lifecycle states. Do not expose secret values or count a metadata version row as deployed rotation. Delete/revoke preserve dependency/retention checks.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.

families.semantics: Tenant export/erase/restore includes content, scalar, financial, support, protected-resource and manifest boundaries. A manifest export is not full content export; restore must not synthesize missing identity/file-writer bindings. Legal hold, consent and exact tenant/resource isolation remain enforced.
unresolved_capabilities: Canonical Runtime identity/revocation and file-writer/custody bindings for real protected content restore, plus consent/hold-aware end-to-end evidence.

families.semantics: Compliance audit, consent, hold and retention extension preserve evidence and legal constraints. Extending retention is not releasing a hold or proving deletion compliance; normal-caller audit access and independent integrity remain required.
unresolved_capabilities: Current-contract authorized lifecycle, tenant/authorization negatives, duplicate/idempotency/recovery and independent provider/functional evidence.
